metadata.purpose: Compact HTML-grounded engineering eval for CrawlerAI improvement planning.
rules: Captured HTML is the primary source; prior Firecrawl/Tavily values are fallback only when the capture does not expose a reliable field.
Previously curated selected-state values are preserved unless the captured HTML directly contradicts them.
Missing fields are omitted, not asserted null.
Large variant sets use count + dimensions + at most 3 examples; long size lists are omitted.
Dynamic ratings/review counts and volatile/locale-sensitive prices are constraints rather than brittle exact assertions.
The extra Louis Vuitton capture in results.zip is excluded because it was not in the requested URL set.
